theTuningFinale.openOwnerDecision: RESOLVED 2026-08-06 - THE OWNER TOOK THE ALTERNATIVE. Kept here as the audit trail; there is no longer a decision pending. The collision was: the veteran tier (1200-1500g) out-paid sagas.test's pin that THE UNDERSCRIBE (1000g) out-pays every non-planar quest. The interim Wave R resolution let the veteran tier win and carved it out of the pin. The owner instead RAISED THE UNDERSCRIBE to 1600g, so the carve-out is gone and the crown of THE LAST PAGE again out-pays every non-planar quest in the game. THE RAISE CASCADED, and this is the part to remember: THE QUIET BEYOND was itself only 1500g - tied with the top veteran contract - so there was NO headroom above a 1600g crown, and the absolute invariant (nothing out-pays the road's end) would have inverted. THE QUIET BEYOND went 1500 -> 1800 as a FORCED consequence, not as a buff on its own merits. Anyone raising the crown again must move the road's end again; sagas.test now pins that ordering strictly (toBeGreaterThan, not toBeGreaterThanOrEqual) so it cannot drift silently.
theTuningFinale.twoRewardLaddersNotOne: THE THING TO UNDERSTAND BEFORE TOUCHING QUEST REWARDS. Gold and XP are deliberately NOT the same ranking. THE UNDERSCRIBE pays the richest PURSE (1600g, above the whole veteran tier) but its XP stayed at 1200 - far BELOW the veteran tier's 2500-3600. That is intentional: it is a minLevel 10 chapter, and handing it veteran-tier XP to match its purse would blow a hole in the level-20 ascent curve the entire finale is built around. So: a tale's crown is the biggest one-time payday; repeatable level-15 field work is the fastest way to level. sagas.test pins BOTH directions - crown gold above every non-planar quest, veteran XP above the crown's and below the road's end - so neither ladder can collapse into the other without a failure.

v13_waveQ2_the_planes.summary: THE PLANES (the capstone; Monstrous Compendium Outer Planes Appendix + DM Option: High-Level Campaigns p.179 INSPIRATION, original text). The wave's thesis is one line from the Appendix: a philosophy holds sway on each outer plane, and that philosophy influences everything on the plane, INCLUDING REALITY ITSELF - so a plane here is not a recoloured floor, it is a LAW that rewrites a rule the hero has leaned on for twenty levels. THE GROUND: new data/planes.ts (PlaneId/PlaneDef/PLANES with ONE law each, PLANE_TUNING, ascensionPrice, the pure planesOpen gate, isPlaneId/planeFor/planeLawFor, and a module-load guard that every plane owns a void-styled palette). Palettes live in data/constants.ts as PLANE_PALETTES BESIDE BIOMES - constants owns palettes and planes.ts imports the type, never the reverse, or the two cycle. BiomePalette gained optional style ('stone'|'void') and darkness. THE PROMISE, pinned from both sides: biomeForFloor still cycles BIOMES and ONLY BIOMES; putting a plane in that table would silently re-shuffle which biome every dungeon floor lands on. PLUMBING: the generator's ONLY change is that biomeFor resolves through the new paletteById (searches both tables, identical for every id that resolved before); TileRenderer draws style:'void' walls as the EDGE OF THE WORLD - a flat well of the plane's dark with a deterministic per-TILE starfield (hashed from tx/ty, never the clock, so it is rock-steady under a moving camera and identical on every replay), fillRect only; Lighting.render takes an optional darkness override so a plane is lit by what it IS. Walls stay WALLS: collision, line of sight, the stairs/key BFS and secret seals all read the same tile - the change is purely what it looks like, which is why the generator's diff is EMPTY. TWELVE FAMILIES, three per plane, each cast for the role its law needs: SILVER VOID (void-lancer fast chase / star-husk armored, its own draw with the void showing through the seams / mote-swarm flit); BRASS MARCHES (brass-warden armored / lantern-sentry ranged, carrying its OWN LightSource beside the fire-beetle and lantern-wisp - the watchman IS the lamp, so seeing it and being seen by it are one event / gear-hound chase); THE CHURNING (chaos-croaker / bone-raker / shape-eater, which walks through what little the plane has settled on being); THE PIT (pit-wretch, a low crawling mass with its own draw / barbed-sentinel / ash-harrier ranged). Twelve new DeathCauses with labels and hints (TS forced every one). ELEVEN of the twelve are `warded`, which is what makes Wave Q1's BREECH the planar key; the Pit's chaff is the deliberate exception. spawnWeightsForFloor gained an early planar branch that REPLACES the dungeon core rather than adding to it, and the planar table ignores depth entirely, because the gate is the RITE, not the floor. THE FOUR LAWS, one read each at an existing seam, all routed through the single pure planeLawFor (never a string compare at a call site): SILVER VOID 'there is no dark, and no cover' (palette darkness 0.14 + a cause-free noCover flag on the AI context - range still applies, the law removes hiding, not distance); BRASS MARCHES 'nothing breaks' (a short-circuit INSIDE moraleBreakChance, so Wave N's rule that the pack's nerve is decided in exactly ONE place still holds - and the Marches field NO morale-flagged type at all, the law stated in data as well as in code); THE CHURNING 'nothing holds its shape' (a slain foe may call one of its kin through, capped at a single generation by an Enemy.gated flag so a room can never run away with itself); THE PIT 'the legion arrives in ranks' (reinforcements on a slow expedition-long clock, never on a lord's floor). FIVE LORDS in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS (silver-lance, brass-arbiter, shapeless-crown, pit-marshal, and the-quiet-beyond at the road's end, hpMult 1.6 - the game's hardest kit); each summons ONLY its own plane's natives, and the classic tier rotation is pinned unchanged through two full cycles. EIGHT QUESTS: four standalone planar CONTRACTS (one per plane, replayable, each ending on its lord) and THE ASCENDANT'S ROAD, four chapters walking all four planes to something the planes are arranged around. QuestDef gained `planar` and SagaDef gained `planar`: STANDALONE_QUEST_IDS now excludes both saga AND planar (Lastlight cannot post work in another world; it was exactly 5 until THE TUNING FINALE's veteran tier made it 9 - see theTuningFinale) and visibleSagaIds excludes planar arcs entirely, so the board and the character sheet never show the road. THE RITE OF ASCENSION: additive SavedHero.ascended (absent sanitizes to false - veterans play exactly as before and simply have a rite left to buy), a temple SERVICE on the LIFT THE CURSE recipe offered ONLY at the level cap and priced off lifetime XP (the book's offering), and the pure stateless planesOpen(hero, cap) = at the cap AND ascended (the Wave G metaUnlocked precedent - the wave's only new system). THE WAYDOOR: the SIXTH station, an arch on the east wall. It is not 'locked' - for an unascended hero it never becomes the nearest station at all, so there is no prompt and E does nothing. Its overlay lists the four contracts and the road's next chapter (the finale stays available to relive, the told-saga rule) and departs through the SAME depart(quest) path the board uses. VETERAN PROMISE (Wave P's rule, inherited whole): the road is NOT founding and NOT meta, so THE LAST PAGE stays exactly as earned; storyComplete still governs the aftermath, pinned by a test that a finished hero's story stage does not move when the road is started OR finished; and THE UNDERSCRIBE was never re-valued - it is still the crown of everything reachable from Lastlight, with the road's end the crown of the whole game. METRICS: TWO new keys in all four places, planes_walked (distinct planes entered this run) and lords_slain (42 -> 44); +4 achievements (50 -> 54). TWO GUARDRAIL VALVES, both found by asking 'whose job is this really?' (the Q1 lesson): systems/Reinforcements.ts now owns 'the floor sends more monsters' - Wave N's camp die and THE PIT's ranks turned out to be the same act on different clocks, so the act lives there and the clocks stay with their owners; and the DARKNESS COMPOSITE moved into rendering/lights.ts beside gatherLights, which was always its home (the Wave C 'view assembly lives with the views' rule - the orchestrator had been holding half the pass). THREE DESIGN BUGS THE TESTS CAUGHT, all real: the planar heavies were written at 2d4+1 and then 2d4, both of which out-hit a boss's blow - hitpoints.test's invariant that no ordinary foe out-hits a boss is right, and they are 1d8 now; the four planar contracts would have appeared on Lastlight's own board until QuestDef.planar existed; and the road's epilogue ran past the 65-word 'short beats' house rule and was trimmed rather than the rule loosened. Suites 21 -> 22 (+planes.test.ts, 26 tests: the plane/palette data contract incl. one-law-each; THE PROMISE that the dungeon cycle is untouched from both sides; paletteById across both tables and its nulls; the planar core (three each, twelve total, no dungeon foes, depth-independent) and the warded count; each of the four laws ON and OFF; the lords off the rotation with the rotation pinned, and each lord summoning only its own plane; the eight quests' contract incl. none on the board and the board still holding five; the road walking all four planes; the veteran promise three ways; ascended sanitize, planesOpen from both sides, the offering price, the temple's cap gate and the Waydoor's offers fresh/mid-road/walked-out; and through the LIVE game - a planar expedition building a VOID floor with only planar foes and counting planes_walked, the Waydoor absent before the rite and open after, and the rite paying, setting, saving and turning away a hero one gold short) = 366 dungeon tests. CONSCIOUS updates only: the morale flag set 10 -> 14, bestiary's 'every type is reachable' narrowed to the DUNGEON with a companion test that every planar type is reachable through its own plane and no other, ascent's warded pin narrowed to the dungeon's three, quest count 21 -> 29, saga count 5 -> 6, 'the meta arc reads last' restated as 'reads last ON THE BOARD', visibleSagaIds' contract widened to hide planar arcs always, the reward crown restated at two tiers, and the characterization metric pin 42 -> 44. Full dev 714/714 (61 suites); release 10/10; type-check and lint clean, every dungeon file under the guardrail.

v13_waveQ1_the_long_ascent.summary: THE LONG ASCENT (the capstone's first half; DM Option: High-Level Campaigns Ch. 7 'Skills for High-Level Characters' INSPIRATION, original text). THE ROAD WAS RE-CUT for this: the owner asked for a level cap of 20 before the planes may be entered, which was not in the Wave Q brief and roughly doubled it, so Q became Q1 (this) + Q2 THE PLANES. Q1 ships on its own merits — the road's 'no dead mechanics between waves' rule is exactly why the Rite of Ascension is NOT here: a rite that opens a door onto nothing would be one. THE CURVE: LEVEL_CAP 10 -> 20; LEVEL_CURVE grows to 21 entries with the dungeon-era rows 1-10 VERBATIM (pinned by test — a level-10 veteran sits exactly where it always sat) and ten ascent rows whose deltas climb 2400 -> 7600, putting level 20 at ~55,400 lifetime XP; LEVEL_GAINS 9 -> 19 rows per class keeping the SAME grammar (thief stride at 11/14/17 continuing its thirds, mage pool at 11/13/15/17/19 continuing its halves, fighter/cleric empty at 11-20 exactly as at 2-10 — their growth is the best hit dice plus the boons they draft); PLAYER.HP_CAP 120 -> 240 (a god-rolled fighter is 10 + 19x10 = 200 before CON/gear/Toughness — the ceiling must never be what stops an honest pool); PROGRESSION.PRESSURE_HP_CAP 1.45 -> 1.75 with the per-level RATE UNCHANGED, so a level-10 hero meets precisely the resistance it always did and only 11-20 pushes past the old ceiling. NO SAVE-SHAPE CHANGE AT ALL: hpRolls sanitize already wanted exactly level-1 entries and backfilled the average, so veterans keep their nine kept rolls and simply have ten levels left to earn. THE GREAT BOONS (the wave's heart, and what makes 11-20 feel like a different tier rather than more of the same): ten new boons, BOONS 10 -> 20, total stacks 19 -> 32. BoonDef gained optional `minLevel` and `classId`; the gate is ONE filter in ProgressionController.draftChoices reading the level being REACHED (hero.level + 1 >= minLevel) — the Wave J spell-band precedent exactly, and like Wave J the SANITIZE deliberately does NOT band-check (a learned boon is learned; banding is a draft rule, not a save rule — pinned by test). The ten ORIGINAL boons stay unbanded and classless, so a hero's first ten levels draft bit-for-bit as before (also pinned). FOUR ANY-CLASS: HARDINESS (11, x2 — each blow soaked by 1, and a blow ALWAYS lands: the floor is 1), DREAD (11, x2 — packs break sooner; fed INTO moraleBreakChance as a new argument rather than adjusted at the call site, so the Wave N law stays designed in exactly ONE place and CHANCE_CAP still has the last word), INNER FOCUS (13, x2 — every learned page returns sooner, techniques included), SIGNATURE ITEM (15, x1 — worn equipment's FLAT effects amplified; ability-score bonuses deliberately NOT, the boon deepens the gear rather than re-rolling the hero). SIX CLASS-KEYED: BREECH (fighter 11 — bites the new EnemyConfig.warded flag, carried by exactly wraith/shade/gargoyle, 2e's 'hit only by magical weapons'; THIS IS Q2'S PLANAR KEY, planted early so it pays for itself now), DEATH BLOW (fighter 15 — a sword blow may fell a plain foe outright; never an elite, never a dagger, and it kills through the REAL path so drops/splits/morale/metrics all fire as for any kill), EVASION (thief 11 — shrugs a blast or trap WHOLE, and specifically not a creature's blow, which is 2e's own rule), SHADOW STEP (thief 15 — the dash ends in a hidden window, reusing the very hiddenTimer the backstab read already consults), SMITE (cleric 13 — the turning wave stops merely shoving the living; the undead branch is untouched, pinned by test), SPELL SCULPTING (mage 13, x2 — a working's REACH and COUNT, never its damage, threaded into castSpell as one scalar exactly like scholarMult rather than smeared across a dozen cases). GUARDRAIL VALVE: the wave pushed the orchestrator to 1529 logical, so THREE things moved to where they actually belonged — (1) the ABSORPTION CHAIN (stone-sense / EVASION / Blur Cloak) became Player.absorbBlow(kind, rng), since every branch is Player state asking about Player state; it returns which absorption fired so damagePlayer keeps the funnel, the consequences and the feedback, and it takes a cause-free BlowKind ('trap'|'blast'|'blow') so Player never learns the bestiary; (2) SIGNATURE ITEM's amplification moved into Inventory.mergedEffects(signatureMult) — Inventory owns the worn set; (3) scholarMult/sculptMult became Player reads, being pure boon reads. Orchestrator back under 1500. HUD: the character sheet's TRAINING list tightens its pitch past eight boons so TRAINING + grimoire + trade-skills still fit the panel — the ascent band can leave a hero holding a dozen-plus, and the old layout would have walked off the bottom of the screen. METRICS: NONE added (42 keys unchanged, characterization pin untouched); +2 achievements on the EXISTING character_level key, dungeon_the_long_ascent (15) and dungeon_the_pinnacle (20), 48 -> 50. ZERO new inputs, sounds, DeathCauses or save fields; the generator's git diff is EMPTY. Suites 20 -> 21 (+ascent.test.ts, 35 tests: the curve's shape and its verbatim 1-10 rows, each ascent step costing more than the last, levelForXp/xpIntoLevel at the new cap, nineteen gain rows and the per-class grammar, the HP ceiling, level pressure unchanged at 10; the band gate from BOTH sides (reaching 11 opens it, reaching 10 never does), each deeper band in turn, class-keying in all four directions, a maxed great boon leaving the pool, and THE PROMISE that the ten originals stay unbanded/classless; sanitize accepting 20 and dropping 21, a level-10 veteran's nine rolls surviving and climbing to 11, sanitize NOT band-checking; and every one of the ten folds — the Player-level ones as units (HARDINESS soak + its floor of 1 + touching nothing else, INNER FOCUS, SHADOW STEP, DREAD against the law and its cap, the pinned warded set) and the rng/Combat ones through the LIVE game (EVASION shrugging a boom but never a creature's blow, HARDINESS showing the ACTUAL wound per the Wave L rule, BREECH biting only the warded, DEATH BLOW felling through the real path with enemies_slain counting it while sparing elites and daggers, SMITE biting the living while leaving the undead branch alone, SIGNATURE ITEM through a real worn DAWNSLIVER, SPELL SCULPTING widening reach but not damage)) = 339 dungeon tests. CONSCIOUS updates only: progression.test's boon-contract count 10 -> 20 (its stack floor still DERIVES from LEVEL_CAP, which is exactly why raising the cap failed it until the ten new cards landed — the canary worked) and one test rename for the row count. Five new DeathCauses (slag_thrall/barrow_hound/brine_lash/cinder_bloat/lantern_wisp) with CAUSE_LABELS + CAUSE_HINTS + causeForEnemy cases (TS forced all of it). Draws: the behavior-keyed switch is already config-coloured so the thrall rode the armored path free and the barrow-hound joined the cinder-hound's quadruped branch; the weird (a risen rope of standing water), the bloat (a sagging sack that swells to throw) and the wisp (a hanging flame with a corona) got small custom branches, jest-safe verbs only. TWO ARCS (newQuest/newSaga): THE DROWNED CHOIR (sunken, chapters the-listening-shallows/the-hall-of-hymns/the-flood-cantor at levels 4/5/6, unique kit 'flood-cantor') and THE ASH THAT REMEMBERS (ash, the-grey-drifts/the-unburnt-door/the-grey-effigy at 7/8/9, unique kit 'grey-effigy') — every biome now has a tale, and both unique kits live in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS beside the rotation (the tier rotation is pinned unchanged through two full cycles). 6 quests + 6 interludes, all prose original; quest count 15 -> 21, saga count 3 -> 5, STANDALONE_QUEST_IDS still exactly 5. Same class, second place: storyStage's 'aftermath' read allSagasTold, which would have walked a finished hero BACK a story stage the moment a side tale existed — it now reads the new pure storyComplete() (founding + meta arcs). Same class, third place: the 'Tell every saga the depths hold' achievement was REWORDED, never re-valued (raising its threshold from 3 would have taken back what players already unlocked). The meta arc also moved LAST in declaration order so the capstone still reads last on the board. METRICS: NONE added (42 keys unchanged — the characterization pin was untouched all wave); +2 achievements on existing keys, dungeon_the_wider_world (sagas_completed >= 5) and dungeon_full_menagerie (unique_slain >= 15), 46 -> 48. Suites 19 -> 20 (+widerworld.test.ts, 21 tests: the five configs + their causes, the ranged-config contract, biome homing incl. the wisp belonging to none, every floor gate from BOTH sides, floor-1 gentleness, the wisp's light present/absent/extinguished-on-death; the two arcs' data contract (one biome each, climbing levels, paired interludes), dressing on every arc + meta reads last, the unique kits off the rotation + the rotation pinned, and THE VETERAN PROMISE (founding gate open with only the founding pair told, storyComplete keeping the aftermath, side-tales-only opening nothing); liveSagaId none/live/told/over-count/tie-order; mixHex walk + clamp + bad-data totality; dressedPalette identity vs tint; banner spots clear of every station; and through the LIVE game — a mid-arc hero walks into a dressed town, an untouched or finished hero gets the town exactly as it was) = 304 dungeon tests. CURSES: new data/curses.ts — CurseId leaden-blood/dim-sight/hungry-wound/misers-shadow, CurseDef {id,name,blurb,icon,color}, CURSE_TUNING (VEIL_CHANCE 0.5, CURSE_CHANCE 0.35, LEADEN_SPEED_MULT 0.9, DIM_TORCH_MALUS 1, HUNGRY_HEAL_MALUS 2, MISER_GOLD_MULT 0.5, LIFT_PRICE_BASE 60 + 15/level). Dies for the expedition ('THE SELLSWORD FALLS'), re-placed beside the hero each loadFloor while alive, null'd in resetExpedition; not saved. TileRenderer.drawHireling (leather/steel + hp sliver, jest-safe verbs). v5_waveF_vaults_and_reliquaries.summary: ITEMS: data/items.ts — 12 original finds across EquipSlot weapon/armor/trinket (per slot: 1 common / 2 rare / 1 legendary), ItemDef.effects = flat additive bag {damage,hp,speed,knockback,daggerCap,statBonus}; trinket statBonus feeds Wave E effective scores live via stats.withStatBonus + ProgressionController.equippedStatDeltas (no cap — statMod flooring self-limits); ITEM_TUNING holds every knob (satchel 6, stash 10, DUPE_GOLD 25/75/200, drop chances/weights); helpers itemsOfRarity/rollItemDrop/bossItemWeights/mergeItemEffects. DROPS (generator untouched — live rng at game level): killBoss ALWAYS drops one (rarity by quest bossTier, classic floors fall back to floor/3), elite kills 12%, treasure-room key opening + secret-room reveal 35% via game.dropItemInRoom (SecretRoomsHost.onSecretFound now passes the revealed room's rect); PickupKind += 'item' carrying Pickup.itemId; TileRenderer strongbox with the find's glow. THE PACK: systems/Inventory.ts behind InventoryHost — run satchel (full = the find stays lying, scroll precedent; banner + I-to-equip hint), equipped worn set seeded from hero.equipment at depart (BEFORE provisions so dagger caps see items), wear/swap returns the displaced piece whence the new came; KeyI flips GameState 'inventory' (Tab-sheet freeze clone: inventoryReturn, case dispatch, inTownWorld clause, monkey key). TOWN MODE edits the SAVED hero directly (equipment/stash + save). Player.applyEquipment folds the merged bag beside gear/boons/statMods (hp moves the ceiling by delta, floor 2/1 safety); DraftFlowHost.refreshStatMods keeps milestone bumps equipment-aware. BANKING: SavedHero.equipment (slot-legality sanitize) + stash (whitelist/dedup/cap) — additive, no version bump, written ONLY at victory + town edits (death path writes NOTHING); openVictory banks worn + satchel->stash, dupes/overflow -> gold folded into banked BEFORE the ledger (rows FINDS KEPT / DUPLICATES SOLD); recap row FINDS LOST TO THE DEEP (RecapStats.itemsLost); sheet gains a compact Worn line; HUD satchel pip. GUARDRAIL VALVE: systems/PickupResolver.ts extracted FIRST (collect switch + grantRelic + keyed doors behind a host; counters/metrics stay in the game callbacks; proven pure — all 135 pre-wave tests green with zero edits). ONE new metric items_found in all four places + 1 achievement (33 total; 37 metric keys); monkey += KeyI. Suites 11->12 (+items.test.ts 15: data contract, merging, weighted drops, satchel cap, victory banking + dupe gold, death-writes-nothing + lostCount, town-mode swap, sanitize, Player folds incl. the pinned 5-damage composition, equippedStatDeltas boundaries) = 150 dungeon tests.

v5_waveE_the_six_scores.summary: SCORES: data/stats.ts — StatId str/dex/con/int/wis/cha, STAT_BASES per class (2e-flavored arrays, each sums 72; favored pair deliberately ODD so the first milestone bump crosses a modifier boundary), STAT_FAVORED, STAT_TUNING (every magnitude), statMod = floor((score-10)/2), statModDeltas (gameplay reads the DELTA vs class base — flat base = zero deltas = the pre-stats game EXACTLY; deltas floor at 0), rollStatScores (base + 2 seeded variance points at forge, AFTER the name pick so name rng order is pinned), isStatMilestone (3/6/9). PERSISTENCE: SavedHero.scores (additive, no version bump; sanitize clamps [classBase, 18], absent field -> flat base so veterans keep their playtested feel; field is `scores`, NEVER confuse with hero.stats the record). FOLDS: Player.statMods + applyProgression 4th arg + setStatMods (mid-run bump heals the CON delta) — STR->swordDamage+meleeKnockback, DEX->speed+dashCooldownFull (new helper, both dash sites), CON->maxHp (CON_HP 2), WIS->heartHealBonus; Player.spellCooldownFull applies INT inside startSpellCooldown (HUD pip divides by it); Combat: INT damage on burning-hands/fireball, WIS on cure/bless; ProgressionController.grantXp x(1+0.05·wis); game: hagglerPrice += cha·0.05, openVictory rewardGold x(1+0.05·cha) (ledger shows the talked-up number). DRAFT: DraftPick += {kind:'stat'}; milestone levels lead draftChoices with favored cards (<18) before the shuffled pool; confirmLevelUp +1 clamp 18, NO session counter (boons_chosen stays boons); renderBoonDraft three-way def lookup. SHEET: six-cell score strip (score + modifier, favored in class color) under the XP bar; columns shifted 170->196. GUARDRAIL VALVE: progression/DraftFlow.ts extracted FIRST (class select + level-up draft flow behind a narrow host; proven pure — all 113 pre-wave tests green with zero edits) putting DungeonCrawlGame back under 1500. ZERO new metric keys/inputs/sounds — characterization contract + monkey untouched. Suites 10->11 (+stats.test.ts 22: data contract, modifier table, delta floor, seeded forge roll, milestones, sanitize clamps, round-trip, draft cards, Player fold siblings of the UNCHANGED maxHp===18 zero-delta pin, WIS xp) = 135 dungeon tests; town victory test consciously derives reward gold from the forged hero's CHA delta (forge roll is live rng there).

v4_waveD_grimoire_manual_sheet.summary: GRIMOIRE: data/spells.ts — six class-gated spells (mage: burning-hands short player blast / frost-ray radius stun / blink teleport+i-frames via host.findOpenSpotNear; cleric: cure-wounds heal / bless haste+1hp / sanctuary stoneskin+invuln; scholar boon deepens cure+sanctuary). Caster level-up drafts mix unlearned spells among boon cards via ProgressionController.DraftPick (draftChoices/confirmLevelUp replaced boonChoices; martial drafts unchanged); learned spells persist as additive SavedHero.spells (class-legal sanitize). V casts the readied spell, G cycles (banner), per-spell cooldowns tick on Player (spellCooldown/startSpellCooldown); HUD spell pip; effects in Combat.castSpell reuse the scroll library (frostNova parameterized). MANUAL: five monsters on existing behavior verbs — salamander (ember 5+, ranged), bone-archer (bone 4+, ranged, undead), drowned-one (sunken 5+, chase, undead), ember-wight (ash 6+, armored — blocks frontal free via behavior, undead), gargoyle (core row ALL biomes 8+, flit). Ranged configs carry boltCause -> Projectile.cause so recaps name the shooter (EnemyUpdateContext.fireBolt += cause); 5 DeathCauses + original labels/hints; undead set now 8. SHEET: Tab toggles a 'sheet' state from playing/town (world frozen; InputManager preventDefaults keydown so Tab is safe); HudRenderer.renderCharacterSheet = identity/XP/record/treasury/gear/sagas/training/grimoire. Guardrail valve: findOpenSpotNear -> TileMap (nullable, host binding keeps the player-pos fallback); ability dispatch (castAbility), hazard damage (updateHazards), nearestEnemyTo, shop product effects (applyShopPurchase) and scroll pickup (collectScroll) -> Combat (CombatHost += hazards/showBanner/grantRelic). Metrics spells_learned/spells_cast (34->36); 2 achievements (32 total); suites 9->10 (+spells.test 7, +1 bestiary gate; monkey keys += KeyV/KeyG/Tab) = 113 dungeon tests.

v4_waveC_sagas_and_secrets.summary: SAGAS: data/sagas.ts — THE PALE PROCESSION (3 bone chapters, unique finale THE GRAVE WARDEN) + THE UNDYING EMBER (4 chapters ember->sunken->ash, unique finale THE CINDER REGENT with the game's largest payouts 800g/1000xp). Chapters = saga-flagged QuestDef entries (QUESTS grew 5->12; STANDALONE_QUEST_IDS keeps the classic board at 5); board gains an Up/Down SAGA page (progress pips, departs on the hero's current chapter; finales relivable, progress never rewinds). Unique kits live in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS BESIDE the rotation (bossKitById; QuestDef.bossKitId -> Boss ctor override) so classic tiers roll unchanged. Interludes (<60 words, original) play via a new 'interlude' state between victory and town; epilogue caps the arc. Per-hero `sagas` chapter map = additive SavedHero field (sanitize clamp, no version bump); ProgressionController.advanceSaga is replay-proof. SECRET ROOMS: generator carves 0-2 sealed pockets into untouched rock per floor (kind 'secret', kept OFF plan.rooms so all room passes + stairs/key BFS invariants hold by construction), sealed by Tile.CrackedWall (solid via the one isSolidTile line; cracked-wall TileRenderer case; minimap free). ONLY player-sourced booms crack seals (Combat blast scan -> host.crackWall; bomber bombs stay 'enemy'). Stock: gold x3-5 + urns + shrine-or-scroll; ~half host a NEST (floor/biome-gated pack pre-rolled in FloorPlan.secrets, spawned by the GAME on entry so level pressure stays out of dungeon/; clear pays run-wallet gold 25+10/floor). systems/SecretRooms.ts tracks reveal/trigger/clear behind a narrow host. Guardrail extraction: recap/victory row assembly + shop-item naming + slim HudState -> HudRenderer; town overlay routing -> TownController.renderOverlay; projectile drawing -> TileRenderer.drawProjectiles (orchestrator back under 1500). Metrics sagas_completed/secrets_found/nests_cleared (31->34 keys); 4 achievements (30 total); suites 7->9 (sagas.test 5, secrets.test 2, +2 generator, +1 store clamp) = 105 dungeon tests.

v1.summary: Core game: seeded rooms-and-corridors floors, torch lighting + fog-of-war minimap, sword/dagger combat, 6 enemy archetypes + mimics, relic draft on descent, Ember Guardian boss every 3rd floor, combo/depth scoring, death recap, full arcade wiring (18th playable game).

v2_depthPass.summary: Dodge dash with i-frames; elite monster modifiers (frenzied/bulwark/volatile/gilded); bomber + wraith enemies; 3-boss rotating roster; 4 floor biomes; spike/vent hazards; destructible urns; merchant shop with spendable gold balance; 4 new relics; 6 new achievements; HudRenderer extracted.

v3_wave1_classes.summary: Four playable classes (Fighter/Thief/Cleric/Mage) picked on a run-start class-select screen (relic-draft pattern, Digit1-4 direct). Each = stat kit + weapon feel + signature Q/L ability (Cleave / Hide in Shadows / Turn Undead / Fireball). Passives: backstab 2x from behind, thief +25% gold drops, cleric heal bonus, mage homing mana bolts with regen. systems/Combat.ts extracted from the orchestrator (killEnemy/hitBoss/explosions/shockwaves + ability effects) for guardrail headroom. 5 metric keys + 5 achievements.

v3_wave2_bestiary.summary: Per-biome monster families (7 new types + 1 mini, ALL reusing existing behavior verbs): ember=fire-beetle (emits real torchlight), bone=zombie+ghoul, sunken=deep-ooze (splits)+lizardman, ash=shade (through walls)+cinder-hound. spawnWeightsForFloor(floor, biomeId) with v2 gates intact; splitsInto generalizes slime division; undead tags feed Turn Undead; 7 DeathCauses; undead_slain + unique_slain metrics + 2 achievements.

v4_waveA1_roster_and_waveB_town.summary: A.1 ROSTER: save v2 = one persistent hero per class (v1 single-hero saves migrate into their slot with stats); every run opens on the hero select (cards show 'NAME · LV n' or UNPROVEN); retire clears only the fallen hero's slot; restart returns to the roster. B LASTLIGHT: session = roster pick -> town (hand-built 26x18 map in town/TownController.ts, synthetic FloorPlan the game loads like a floor; warm TOWN_PALETTE) -> quest board/gate departs on a QUEST (data/quests.ts: 4 authored + Endless; fresh seed per expedition; quest pins biome via generator FloorOpts {forceBoss, biomeId} — omitted opts reproduce classic rules bit-for-bit; boss ONLY on the final floor, tier from the quest) -> stairs after the final boss = VICTORY overlay: carried goldBalance + rewardGold bank into hero.gold, rewardXp granted, stats.victories++, return to town SAME session. Death still recap->endGame (hero endures, carried gold lost, banked safe). BLACKSMITH: 4 permanent gear tracks x3 tiers (data/gear.ts, banked gold, saved per hero, folded in Player like boons). ALCHEMIST: one-expedition provisions (field-scroll/bandolier/blessed-candle) consumed at the gate. HUD gold shows the treasury in town, the run wallet below. Line-budget enforcement: boss director (updateBoss/pickTeleportSpot) + castScroll effects moved into systems/Combat (host += addProjectile/revealMap); draft nav consolidated. Metrics quests_completed + gold_banked; 3 achievements; town.test.ts (10).

v4_waveA_character.summary: PERSISTENT HERO per arcade account: class pick forges a character (auto-named from HERO_NAMES via seeded rng) saved as versioned JSON under localStorage key dungeon-crawl-save:<ownerId> (owner from hacktivate-session-owner, fallback guest; validated on load, silent try/catch everywhere). 2e-flavored XP per monster (EnemyConfig.xp; elites x3, bosses +200), LEVEL_CURVE to cap 10, per-class hit-die LEVEL_GAINS (fighter/cleric 20hp, thief 15hp+speed, mage 13hp+mana), mid-run level-ups open a 'levelUp' boon draft (10 persistent proficiency boons with maxStacks). Death banks everything (recordDeath); hold R on the recap to retire. Level pressure (enemy hp x 1+0.05/level, cap 1.45) keeps floor 1 honest — applied at Enemy construction, generator untouched. HUD gains LV + XP bar. RESTART SEMANTICS CHANGED: restart resumes the saved hero (classes.test updated deliberately). New: data/progression.ts, data/boons.ts, data/causes.ts (extraction), persistence/CharacterStore.ts, progression/ProgressionController.ts, __tests__/progression.test.ts (18). 4 metric keys + 4 achievements.

v3_wave3_loot.summary: Vaults of the Magica: relic pool 12 -> 18 (Ring of Renewal hp regen / War Bracers ability CD / Grave Ward vs undead / Ogre Gauntlets knockback / Blur Cloak dodge / Bottomless Quiver dagger regen) + UNIDENTIFIED SCROLLS: one satchel slot, read with F/O; identity rolls from the live rng at pickup (generator stays pure). Five scrolls: Flame (player blast), Frost (stuns all in sight — reuses Enemy.stunned), Healing, Shielding (stoneskin + invuln), Revelation (reveals minimap). Found on floors (~50%), in urns, and as a 35g shop mystery. BombInFlight refactored to carry an explicit boom payload (bomber/fireball/scroll = one path). scrolls_used metric + 1 achievement. achievements.ts crossed the 1500-line guardrail and its 26 dungeon entries were extracted to src/data/dungeonCrawlAchievements.ts.

architecture.overview: One BaseGame subclass orchestrates pure/seeded generation, data-driven entities, stateless renderers, and stateful Combat + SecretRooms systems behind narrow host interfaces. Every file stays under the 1500-logical-line ESLint guardrail (Wave C valve: view assembly lives with the views — recap/victory rows in HudRenderer, town overlay routing in TownController, projectiles in TileRenderer).

files.DungeonCrawlGame.ts: Orchestrator: state machine (classSelect/playing/relic/recap), input edges, ability dispatch, scoring, metrics sync, service calls. Combat resolution and screen-space drawing are delegated.
files.data/constants.ts: ALL tuning: player/dash, combat/combo, pickups, shop prices, hazard cycle, explosion fuses, shockwave, lighting, overlay timing, BIOMES palette table + biomeForFloor().
files.data/classes.ts: v3 — ClassId/ClassKit/ClassDef, CLASSES (4 kits incl. tunic/trim sprite colors + ability blurbs), DEFAULT_KIT (reproduces the pre-v3 hero exactly; active until the pick), CLASS_TUNING (ability numbers).
files.data/sagas.ts: v4 Wave C — SagaId/SagaDef/SAGAS (chapters = ordered QuestIds, interludes 1:1 with chapters, last = epilogue) + pure helpers sagaChapterForQuest/chaptersDone/currentChapter. v5 Wave G: THE LAST PAGE is meta:true, hidden until every FOUNDING saga is TOLD via the pure sagaTold/metaUnlocked/visibleSagaIds helpers (board, sheet and storyStage all read them). Wave P: 5 arcs (a tale per biome) + SagaDef.founding (the meta gate reads THIS, never !meta) + storyComplete (founding+meta = the story is over; storyStage's aftermath reads it, NOT allSagasTold) + SagaDef.dressing + the pure stateless liveSagaId (the town's dressing reads it every frame; nothing is saved). The meta arc is declared LAST so the capstone reads last on the board. Module-load guards pin interlude pairing, saga flags, and that a founding arc exists at all.
files.data/npcs.ts: v5 Wave G — the townsfolk of THE LAST LANTERN: NpcId/NpcDef/NPCS (5 named originals with icon/color/title) + rumor pools per StoryStage + the PURE STATELESS storyStage(hero) (level + saga progress -> arrival/delving/the-page/aftermath; magnitudes in NPC_TUNING; no save field). Rumors roll from the game's live rng via TownCtx.pickRumor.
files.progression/QuestDirector.ts: v5 Wave G — the quest expedition lifecycle extracted from the orchestrator: depart (re-arm hero -> provisions -> save; stages the DM briefing), openVictory (banking, saga advance, ledger; clears stale briefings), updateVictory/updateInterlude (PendingInterlude.onDismiss 'town'|'descend' — briefings descend via loadFloor at dismiss), arrive (banner + gate level-up). DraftFlow conventions: narrow host, update methods return GameState|null, metric counters stay in the game's callbacks.
files.data/boons.ts: v4 — persistent level-up training (relics are run-scoped magic; boons are learned skill). Wave Q1 — 20 entries now: the ten originals (unbanded, classless, FROZEN) plus THE GREAT BOONS, ten banded to levels 11/13/15/17 with four any-class and six class-keyed via new optional BoonDef.minLevel/classId. The band gate is ONE filter in ProgressionController.draftChoices; sanitize never band-checks. GREAT_BOON_IDS is the derived list (anything gated above level 1). All magnitudes in BOON_TUNING.
files.data/progression.ts: v4 — the XP curve, per-class gain rows, level-pressure knobs and hero names. Wave Q1 — LEVEL_CAP 20: the curve is 21 entries with rows 1-10 VERBATIM from the dungeon era and ten ascent rows whose deltas climb 2400 -> 7600 (level 20 at ~55,400 lifetime XP — the wave's first knob); LEVEL_GAINS is 19 rows per class in the same grammar it always had. PRESSURE_HP_CAP 1.75, per-level RATE unchanged.
files.data/curses.ts: Wave O — the four curses (leaden-blood/dim-sight/hungry-wound/misers-shadow): CurseId/CurseDef/CURSES/ALL_CURSE_IDS + asCurseId (sanitize fallback to null) + CURSE_TUNING (veil/curse chances, the four malus magnitudes, temple lift prices). Pure data; Player folds the maluses, PickupResolver rolls the veil, TownController sells the cure.
files.entities/Hireling.ts: Wave O — THE SELLSWORD's deliberately DUMB body: position/hp/timers/facing only. All behavior lives in Combat.updateHireling; enemies never target it and no faction concept exists.
files.progression/RecapFlow.ts: Wave O valve — the death-recap overlay lifecycle (timer, hold-R retirement, dismiss -> endGame) behind a narrow host. The GAME still assembles RecapStats (its counters) and hands them to open().
files.data/lineages.ts: Wave I — the four bloodlines: LineageId/LineageDef/LINEAGES (HUMAN deliberately first = the neutral card), LINEAGE_TUNING (human forge bonus, elf sheath, halfling escape), asLineageId (sanitize fallback), applyLineageNudge (forge fold, clamped). Passives consumed in Player; the pick lives in DraftFlow/HudRenderer.
files.data/spells.ts: v4 Wave D, deepened v6 Wave J — SpellId/SpellDef/SPELLS (18 pages, class-gated via classId: 6 mage + 6 cleric + 3 fighter + 3 thief TECHNIQUES) + minLevel level bands (existing six = 1, new pages 4/6/8) + spellsForClass + spellNoun (SPELL vs TECHNIQUE wording) + SPELL_TUNING. Pure data; effects in Combat.castSpell; learning rides the level-up draft (band-gated in draftChoices); V casts / G cycles.
files.data/stats.ts: v5 Wave E — the six ability scores: StatId/StatDef/STATS, STAT_BASES per class + STAT_FAVORED + STAT_TUNING, and the pure functions statMod/zeroStatMods/statModDeltas (deltas vs class base, floored at 0)/rollStatScores (seeded forge variance)/isStatMilestone/withStatBonus (Wave F equipment overlay). Gameplay folds read DELTAS so the flat base reproduces the pre-stats game exactly.
files.data/items.ts: v5 Wave F — 12 findable equipment pieces across weapon/armor/trinket slots with rarities and flat additive ItemEffects (+statBonus for effective scores); ITEM_TUNING (caps, dupe gold, drop chances/weights) + itemsOfRarity/rollItemDrop/bossItemWeights/mergeItemEffects.
files.systems/Inventory.ts: v5 Wave F — the run satchel + worn set + banking rules behind InventoryHost: tryCollect (full leaves the find), wear/swap (town mode edits the SAVED hero directly), bankOnVictory (the ONLY moment finds persist; dupes/overflow -> gold), lostCount (recap). Browse UI state (index/list) the HUD renders from.
files.systems/PickupResolver.ts: v5 Wave F — floor-loot resolution extracted from the orchestrator: the collect-pickup switch, grantRelic, and the keyed treasure-room doors. Mechanics here; counters/metrics stay in the game's host callbacks (onGold/onPotionUsed/onKeyUsed/onRelicCollected, collectScroll -> Combat, collectItem -> Inventory).
files.progression/DraftFlow.ts: v5 Wave E — the run-start class/hero select and the level-up card draft (boons/spells/milestone stat bumps), extracted from the orchestrator behind DraftFlowHost. Owns classIndex/choices/index/returnState (HUD renders from them); update methods return the next GameState or null and the game assigns.
files.systems/SecretRooms.ts: v4 Wave C — runtime secret-room state (revealed/nest triggered/cleared) behind SecretRoomsHost (spawnNest/showBanner/playSound/grantNestReward/onSecretFound/onNestCleared). resetFor(plan.secrets) per floor; update(playerX, playerY) each playing frame.
files.data/enemies.ts: 17 enemy configs (data-driven AI params, undead + splitsInto tags), elite trait table + spawn-chance ramp, spawnWeightsForFloor(floor, biomeId) = common core with v2 floor gates + per-biome family rows, per-room enemy budget, BOSS baseline.
files.data/bosses.ts: The three rotating Guardian kits + bossKitForTier(), PLUS UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS (grave-warden, cinder-regent, and v5 Wave G's underscribe) outside the rotation + bossKitById() — saga finales pin theirs via QuestDef.bossKitId (Boss ctor optional kit override).
files.data/relics.ts: 18 relic definitions + RELIC_TUNING. Relics are stacking counters read by Player.ts (a few consumed in Combat/damagePlayer: grave-ward, blur-cloak).
files.data/scrolls.ts: v3 wave 3 — ScrollId/ScrollDef/SCROLLS/ALL_SCROLL_IDS + SCROLL_TUNING. Pure data; effects dispatch in DungeonCrawlGame.castScroll + Combat.
files.dungeon/rng.ts: Mulberry32 seeded PRNG. Generator and relic drafts fully deterministic per (seed, floor).
files.dungeon/DungeonGenerator.ts: Pure seeded floor generator. pickWeighted derives biome purely from floor number. Exports isReachable (BFS) used by tests.
files.entities/Player.ts: Wave Q1 additions first, since one is a valve: absorbBlow(kind, rng) owns the whole 'did the blow find me at all?' chain (stone-sense -> EVASION -> Blur Cloak, in that ORDER) and returns which absorption fired; BlowKind is deliberately cause-free ('trap'|'blast'|'blow') so Player never learns the bestiary. takeDamage now returns the HP ACTUALLY LOST (0 = absorbed, so the old falsy guard still reads the same) with HARDINESS soaking inside it. scholarMult()/sculptMult() are pure boon reads that moved here from the orchestrator. Otherwise: movement, sword arc, dagger throw, dash, hearts, relic stacking, potion buffs, phoenix revive. v3: `kit` field drives melee range/arc/cooldown/knockback, speed, dagger cap/homing/regen; applyKit(); tryAbility() + abilityCooldownFrac(); startHide() (rides invuln); backstab/heal/gold multipliers read by Combat/game.
files.entities/Enemy.ts: One class interprets all archetypes from config. v3: `stunned` timer (Turn Undead — frozen, no touch damage), ctx.playerHidden drops+blocks aggro every frame (thief hide). Wave N: `fleeTimer` + `breakAndFlee()` (routed flight reuses the wander machinery, facing flipped, all attacks suppressed); `wandering` flag (no lair treasure on death).
files.entities/Boss.ts: Kit-driven phase machine; enrage under 35% HP.
files.entities/Projectile.ts: Bolts + daggers; homing steer reused by mage mana bolts (game passes nearest-enemy target for player daggers, player pos for hostile bolts).
files.entities/Urn.ts: Destructible prop; Combat rolls loot on break.
files.systems/Combat.ts: v3 — extracted combat resolution: hitEnemy (knight block, backstab), woundEnemy, killEnemy (drops, splitsInto division, host stat callbacks), breakUrn, hitBoss/killBoss, bombs/staged explosions (source: enemy|player — player booms never hurt the player)/shockwaves + their rendering, ability effects (cleave/turnUndead/spawnFireball). Wave M valve — the whole ENTITY TURN lives here too: updateSwing (sword vs enemies/boss/urns), updateEnemies (AI ctx + touch dice + in-place compaction), updateProjectiles (homing, bolt-vs-player, dagger-vs-enemy/urn/boss), beside the Wave B updateBoss. Reaches the run ONLY via the CombatHost interface (accessor functions because the game reassigns arrays per floor — which is why compaction is IN PLACE). Exports DeathCause + causeForEnemy. Wave N: killEnemy also sweeps nearby morale-flagged foes (moraleBreakChance on the live rng) and skips the gold scatter for a wandering-flagged kill; healPlayer is now PUBLIC (Rest's canonical heal path too).
files.systems/Lighting.ts: Offscreen darkness buffer + radial holes. SELF-DISABLES without createRadialGradient (jest) — keep this guard.
files.systems/Juice.ts: Wave K — THE SPECTACLE's stateful kit: capped hit-stop freeze (simDt wraps ONLY the updatePlaying call), transient flash-lights appended to the darkness gather, floor-entry curtain scrim. Ticks on REAL dt beside shake/particles/lighting; reset + startCurtain at loadFloor/enterTownWorld; every magnitude in constants JUICE.
files.systems/FloatingText.ts: Wave L — floating combat numbers (dealt pale, taken blood, healed green): capped 40, rise+ease over 0.7s, world-space render after particles, REAL dt (hit-stop never freezes the readout), cleared beside particles. Results only — dice stay internal.
files.systems/ThiefSkills.ts: Wave M — THE ROGUE'S TRADE behind a narrow host: nearest-interactable detection (chest first, then thief-only trap), the lock-pick / key-turn / disarm flows, chest contents rolled at open on the live rng, the HUD prompt state (text + ok + deniedFlash). Counters/metrics stay in the game callbacks (onChestOpened/onTrapDisarmed).
files.entities/Chest.ts: Wave M — locked strongboxes: opened + jiggle (failed-pick feedback the renderer shakes). Indestructible furniture — only a thief's picks or a spent key open one; contents live in ThiefSkills.
files.systems/Rest.ts: Wave N — the stairs camp (ThiefSkills/SecretRooms conventions, narrow RestHost): prompt()/update()/reset()/onPlayerDamaged(). gameplaySystems.classes: Wave L vitals — fighter (d10, opens 10 HP, 120° arc, Cleave 6s) / thief (d6, +14% speed, 8 daggers, +25% gold, 2x backstab from behind or shadows, Hide 1.5s per 10s) / cleric (d8, mace +1dmg slow heavy, hearts heal +2, Turn Undead 8s: 2dmg+1s stun to undead in 140px, shoves the living) / mage (d4, opens 4 HP — deliberately 2e-fragile, weak staff, homing bolts cap 6 regen 1/4s, Fireball 8s: player-sourced 56px boom). All tuning in data/classes.ts.
gameplaySystems.theLongAscent: Wave Q1 — levels 11-20. The cap was 10 for the whole dungeon era; the planes want heroes who have gone twice as far. Past 10 the growth changes KIND (the thesis of DM Option: High-Level Campaigns Ch. 7): the hit die keeps rolling and the class rows keep their old grammar, but the real reward is THE GREAT BOONS — ten cards that only appear in the ascent band, four open to any class and six keyed to one. HARDINESS soaks a point off every blow (never to nothing), DREAD makes packs break sooner, INNER FOCUS returns every page faster, SIGNATURE ITEM deepens what you wear; the fighter learns BREECH (bites the half-real — wraith, shade, gargoyle) and DEATH BLOW (one stroke is sometimes the whole fight), the thief EVASION (blasts and traps find nothing) and SHADOW STEP (out of a dash already behind them), the cleric SMITE (the turning wave scours the living too), the mage SPELL SCULPTING (wider workings, same bite). A hero who never passes 10 plays exactly as it always did.
gameplaySystems.hitPoints: Wave L — THE TRUE MEASURE: level 1 = the class hit die's maximum; each level-up rolls the die live and the hero KEEPS the roll (SavedHero.hpRolls; veterans backfill the average); CON adds its delta per hit die; monster blows are dice rolled internally (trash 1d2, heavies 1d4+1, boss 1d6+1 touch / 2d4 charge); heals are dice (heart 1d6+1, cure 1d8+WIS, SECOND WIND 1d10); revives return at 25% of the pool; 'bloodied' (≤25%) gates the danger stinger and HUD vignette. HUD: heart + vigor bar + numbers; floating combat numbers show results, never dice.
gameplaySystems.lineages: Wave I — chosen once at the forge, saved on the hero: HUMAN/THE UNBOUND (+1 forge variance point, forge-time only), DWARF/STONEBLOOD (+1 CON, first trap each floor bites nothing), ELF/STARLIT (+1 DEX, +1 dagger sheath), HALFLING/HEARTHLUCK (+1 CHA, once-per-expedition death escape after phoenix/survivor). Nudges are single points folded into the forge roll (texture, never a rebalance); all knobs in data/lineages.ts.
gameplaySystems.abilityScores: v5 Wave E — STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA on every hero: class base array (fighter STR17/CON15, thief DEX17/CHA13, cleric WIS17/CON13, mage INT17/DEX13; each sums 72) + 2 seeded variance points at forge. Gameplay reads modifier DELTAS vs the base (flat base = today's feel; veterans default to it). Folds per delta point: STR +1 dmg/+20 knockback, DEX +3% speed/dash cd x0.92, CON +2 hp, INT spell cd x0.9/+1 spell dmg, WIS +1 heal/xp x1.05, CHA shop -5%/quest gold +5%. Milestone levels 3/6/9 lead the level-up draft with the favored pair (odd bases — first bump always crosses a mod boundary). Sheet strip shows score + modifier.
gameplaySystems.bestiary: Biome families on top of the shared core: ember=fire-beetle (emits LightSource r70), bone=zombie (slow hp5) + ghoul (fast, floor 5+), sunken=deep-ooze (splits to 2 minis) + lizardman (floor 3+), ash=shade (through walls, undead) + cinder-hound (speed 105) (floor 4+). Undead set for Turn Undead: skeleton, wraith, zombie, ghoul, shade. Biome ambient floors in the 4-cycle with bosses every 3rd: ember 1/5, bone 2/10, sunken 7/11, ash 4/8.
gameplaySystems.scrolls: One satchel slot; found unidentified (floor ~50%, urn loot band, shop 35g); identity rolls from the LIVE rng at pickup + banner; F/O reads it. flame=player blast r72 dmg3 / frost=stun all in 380px for 2.5s / healing=4hp / shielding=stoneskin+1s invuln / revelation=reveal minimap. Full satchel leaves floor scrolls in place; a bought scroll replaces the held one.
gameplaySystems.sagas: Three arcs on the board's saga page: PALE PROCESSION (bone, minLevel 2/3/4, finale GRAVE WARDEN t3 x1.15hp), UNDYING EMBER (ember->sunken->ash, minLevel 6-9, finale CINDER REGENT t5 x1.25hp), and — v5 Wave G, hidden until BOTH are TOLD — THE LAST PAGE (bone->sunken->ash, minLevel 9/10/10, finale THE UNDERSCRIBE t6 x1.35hp, the reward crown 1000g/1200xp). Chapter N+1 unlocks when N completes for THAT hero; interlude after each chapter victory, epilogue after the finale; completed sagas may relive the finale (progress frozen).
gameplaySystems.theDM: v5 Wave G — every departure opens on the quest's DM briefing (QuestDef.intro, original prose) via the interlude overlay; dismiss descends. THE LAST LANTERN inn hosts five townsfolk whose rumors follow the hero's STORY STAGE (pure stateless storyStage: arrival/delving/the-page/aftermath) — hints ride existing systems, teasers point at the next chapter, and once both sagas are told every voice bends toward the missing last page.
gameplaySystems.theGrimoire: v6 Wave J — 18 persistent pages learned at level-up, ALL classes: mage/cleric 6 spells each, fighter/thief 3 TECHNIQUES each (same pipeline, different noun). minLevel bands gate the draft (1 for the Wave D six, 4/6/8 for everything new) so deep heroes draft deeper magic and fresh heroes play exactly as before. V casts the readied page, G cycles; per-page cooldowns on Player (INT shortens via the delta fold); effects in Combat.castSpell reuse existing verbs only.
gameplaySystems.thiefSkills: Wave M — the rogue's trade: OPEN LOCKS and FIND TRAPS as live percentile skills (base 40/35 + 5/level + 10/DEX-delta, cap 95 — no save field, the sheet shows a TRADE-SKILLS section). Locked chests (floor 2+, ~one per floor + 35% in secret rooms): a thief E-picks free (0.9s retry on a slip), anyone else turns a key (the treasure-room-door tradeoff), contents roll live at open (4-7 gold + scroll/potion/equipment/extra-gold bonus). E on a trap plate (thief only, not mid-bite): success stills it forever + a sliver of XP (8+2/floor); failure SPRINGS it under your hands — the existing bite lands. Prompts show the percent (a readied chance, never dice).
gameplaySystems.secretRooms: 0-2 per non-boss floor, sealed by a CrackedWall only PLAYER booms open (mage fireball, flame scroll). Dark (no torches), stocked with gold + urns + shrine-or-scroll; ~50% host a nest that stirs on entry — clear the spawned pack for run-wallet gold (SECRETS.NEST_REWARD_BASE + PER_FLOOR). All knobs in data/constants.ts SECRETS.
gameplaySystems.templeAndCurse: Wave O — the temple and the curse. VEILED SHRINE RELICS: a shrine find may arrive VEILED (50%) — real power, hidden name ('?' in the tally) — and a veiled find may be a LIE (35%): no relic, a CURSE seizes the hero (one of four run-long maluses: slower stride / dimmer torch / weaker heart heals / half gold). One curse at a time; it CLINGS at run end (death OR victory) until lifted. THE TEMPLE in Lastlight (E at the chapel): LIFT THE CURSE (banked gold, 60 + 15/level), RITE OF AUGURY (45g — next delve shrine finds arrive named and cursed shrines are refused), WARDING CHRISM (35g — the first curse burns away and the cleansed relic is granted; hearts mend +1), and THE SELLSWORD (75g — a hired blade follows for one expedition, strikes 1d3, has 12 HP, takes touch damage when it wades in, dies for good). Draft + dungeon-shop relics are never veiled.
gameplaySystems.livingDepths: Wave N — the depths react. MORALE: living, pack-minded foes (nine types, never undead/mindless/mimic) roll to BREAK when a nearby packmate falls (moraleBreakChance — base odds rise when the pack is thinned below half its seeded strength or the hero outlevels the floor, capped at 60%); a broken foe runs FLEE_TIME seconds, attacks nothing, and shows its back (frontal blocks drop, backstabs land) before steadying to re-acquire naturally. REST: camp at a cleared floor's stairs (off the descent tile) to heal 1d4 every 1.6s through the same canonical heal path as every other cure — but the longer the fire burns the more the wander die climbs, and a hit ends the rest. WANDERING MONSTERS: a single-type pack (2-4, level-pressured, no lair treasure — kills scatter no gold) answers the dark, spawns clear across the floor, and is an ordinary threat in every way — it can even be routed by the morale it just proved it needed.
gameplaySystems.coreLoop: Pick class -> explore floor -> fight -> loot -> optional treasure room (key) -> optional shop -> stairs -> relic draft -> descend. Boss arena every 3rd floor.
gameplaySystems.economyRule: CRITICAL: gold is two numbers. `pickups` (BaseGame) is CUMULATIVE arcade economy — never decrement. `goldBalance` is the run wallet the shop drains. Thief gold bonus multiplies drop COUNT only.
gameplaySystems.scoring: kill score x combo (x1-x5) x depth multiplier; gold +15; +10/room; floor-clear 150+75*floor; boss bonus 1000.
gameplaySystems.bosses: Tier = floor/3. Ember Guardian / Bone Colossus / Hollow King rotation with HP_PER_TIER scaling.
gameplaySystems.relicDraftDeterminism: Stair drafts seeded from (runSeed ^ floor*0x85ebca6b). Shrine/shop relics use the live rng. Class choice is user input — no rng.
gameplaySystems.thePlanes: Wave Q2 - what lies past the gate for a hero who has ascended. THE RITE at the temple (level 20, an offering worth a whole life) opens THE WAYDOOR, a sixth station in Lastlight. Beyond it are four worlds, and each one is a LAW: THE SILVER VOID (an endless bright day over drifting islands - there is no dark, and nothing to hide behind); THE BRASS MARCHES (a country ruled into squares - nothing here loses its nerve, ever); THE CHURNING (raw possibility still deciding - what you kill has other drafts, and one may step through after it); THE PIT (cruelty with a filing system - the garrison is relieved on schedule whatever you do). Twelve natives, three per plane, and almost all of them shrug plain steel - which is what makes a fighter's BREECH the key to the whole act. Four repeatable contracts, one per plane, each ending on that plane's lord; and THE ASCENDANT'S ROAD, four chapters that walk all four and end at the thing they are arranged around.

doNotBreak: Wave Q2 - biomeForFloor cycles BIOMES and ONLY BIOMES, forever. Planar palettes live in PLANE_PALETTES beside it and are reached ONLY by name through paletteById. Putting a plane in BIOMES would silently re-shuffle which biome every dungeon floor lands on (pinned from both sides).

Wave Q2 - WALLS STAY WALLS. style:'void' is a RENDERING choice: collision, line of sight, the stairs/key BFS and secret-room seals all read the same tile they always did. Never let a palette field change what a tile IS.

Wave Q2 - every law read goes through the pure planeLawFor (an ordinary floor answers with an empty law). Never compare a biome id to a plane name at a call site, and never give a law a second effect - one plane says one thing.

Wave Q2 - THE BRASS MARCHES law lands INSIDE moraleBreakChance, not as a skipped sweep, so Wave N's rule that a pack's nerve is decided in exactly ONE place survives. THE CHURNING's gating is capped by Enemy.gated (a gated foe never gates) so a room can never run away with itself. THE PIT's ranks never fire on a boss floor.

Wave Q2 - the planar spawn table REPLACES the dungeon core; nothing from the depths spawns past the gate and no planar family spawns in the depths (both pinned). A planar family belongs to exactly ONE plane.

Wave Q2 - the generator learns nothing about the planes beyond resolving a palette id. Laws, gating and reinforcements all apply at GAME level (the Wave C nest / Wave N wandering-pack precedent); level pressure never enters dungeon/.

Wave Q2 - planar work is never posted in Lastlight: STANDALONE_QUEST_IDS excludes saga AND planar (still exactly 5) and visibleSagaIds excludes planar arcs ALWAYS - not 'until unlocked', but never. The Waydoor lists them instead.

Wave Q2 - the Waydoor is not a locked door: for an unascended hero it never becomes the nearest station, so there is no prompt and E cannot open it. planesOpen needs BOTH the cap and the rite, and SavedHero.ascended is written ONLY by the temple's rite, never by a run.

Wave Q2 - the road inherits Wave P's veteran promise in full: it is NOT founding and NOT meta (THE LAST PAGE stays as earned), storyComplete still governs the aftermath (a finished hero's stage must not move when the road is started or finished), and THE UNDERSCRIBE was reworded around, never re-valued.
Wave Q2 - lords live in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS only and each summons ONLY its own plane's natives. The classic tier rotation must not shift (pinned through two full cycles).

Wave Q2 - NOTHING THAT IS NOT A BOSS MAY OUT-HIT A BOSS. hitpoints.test pins it against BOSS.TOUCH_DAMAGE and CHARGE_DAMAGE; it caught the planar heavies TWICE during this wave. Deep opposition earns its threat through HP, speed and numbers, not by exceeding a boss's blow.

Wave Q2 valve - systems/Reinforcements.ts owns pack spawning (camp die AND the legion); rendering/lights.ts owns the whole darkness pass, gather and composite. Never resurrect either inline in the orchestrator.
All player damage funnels through damagePlayer(cause). New damage sources need: DeathCause member (systems/Combat.ts) + CAUSE_LABELS + CAUSE_HINTS entries (TS errors if you forget).
Dash AND thief-hide safety ride Player.invuln — never add a damage path that ignores invuln.
Never decrement BaseGame.pickups. Spend from goldBalance only.
Generator stays pure + seeded: no Math.random inside dungeon/. Biome for spawns derives from floor number.
Stairs must be reachable WITHOUT the key (BFS-verified lockRoom).
Every service call optional-chained (this.services?.audio?.playSound?.(...)).
Lighting.ts keeps its createRadialGradient feature-detect no-op.
extendedGameData keys == achievement requirement.type strings; new keys go in syncExtendedData + GameEndData + characterization test, all three.
Input uses edge detection (was-flags updated at END of onUpdate).
Keep every file under the 1500-line guardrail; grow by extracting (HudRenderer, Combat are the precedents).
player-sourced explosions (source: 'player') must never damage the player.
ONLY player-sourced booms crack CrackedWall seals (Combat's blast scan); enemy bombs never reveal secrets.

Secret rooms stay OFF plan.rooms and off the critical path — solid-sealed at generation so stairs/key BFS invariants hold by construction; nest packs spawn at GAME level (level pressure never enters dungeon/).

Saga progress only advances when the completed quest IS the hero's current chapter (ProgressionController.advanceSaga returns null otherwise) — replays must never re-advance, re-reward the metric, or replay interludes.
Unique saga boss kits live in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS, never in BOSS_KITS — the classic tier rotation must not shift.
New undead-flavored monsters get `undead: true` so Turn Undead scales for free; new splitters use `splitsInto` (never hardcode ids in Combat).
Floor 1 stays gentle: slime/skeleton/fire-beetle only (pinned by generator + bestiary tests).

v5 Wave E — gameplay reads ability-score DELTAS vs the class base (statModDeltas, floored at 0): a flat-base hero must play bit-for-bit like the pre-stats game (the progression.test maxHp===18 pin is that contract — never 'fix' it by passing deltas).
v5 Wave E — SavedHero.scores clamp to [class base, 18] in sanitize; the field is `scores`, never to be confused with hero.stats (the expedition record).
v5 Wave E — create() rolls scores AFTER the name pick; never reorder the rng stream.

v5 Wave E — stat picks never increment sessionBoons (boons_chosen stays semantically boons); milestone stat cards appear only when REACHING levels 3/6/9 (tests that draft at level 2 stay all-boon/spell).
v5 Wave F — hero.equipment/hero.stash are written ONLY by Inventory.bankOnVictory and town-mode pack edits; the death path must never touch them (that guarantee IS the items-lost-on-death rule).
v5 Wave F — item drops roll on the LIVE rng at game level (killBoss/elite/dropItemInRoom); the generator never places 'item' pickups.
v5 Wave F — blacksmith gear tracks and found equipment compose additively and stay separate systems (gear = town-forged tiers, items = found pieces); relics stay run-scoped.
v5 Wave G — storyStage is PURE and STATELESS (level + saga progress only); rumors must never require a new save field.

v5 Wave G — THE UNDERSCRIBE lives in UNIQUE_BOSS_KITS only; a meta saga carries meta:true and stays hidden (board AND sheet) until metaUnlocked — its chapters advance through the SAME advanceSaga path (replay-proof for free).
v5 Wave G — hero.equipment-style rule for briefings: openVictory MUST clear pendingInterlude before advanceSaga so a stale departure briefing never replays as a story beat.
v5 Wave G — depart preserves arm->provisions->clear->save; loadFloor fires at the briefing's dismiss ('descend'), never before.

Wave I — HUMAN is the neutral lineage and its perk stays FORGE-TIME ONLY: a veteran hero sanitized to 'human' must play bit-for-bit as before (this extends the Wave E flat-base contract). Never give humans a play-time passive.
Wave I — demihuman statNudges stay SINGLE points (texture, never a rebalance); nudges land at the forge only, clamped 18, and consume NO rng (never reorder the name->scores stream).

Wave I — lineage passives are applied via Player.applyLineage beside applyKit at BOTH arm sites (DraftFlow.enterTown, QuestDirector.depart); a new arm site must call it too or the bloodline silently vanishes.
Wave I — the bloodline page's digits are RELEASE-ARMED; never remove the arming or a held class-pick digit auto-forges a human.

Wave J — the draft's level-band gate reads the level being REACHED (hero.level + 1 >= minLevel) and lives ONLY in ProgressionController.draftChoices; sanitize deliberately does NOT band-check (a learned page is learned — banding is a draft rule, not a save rule).
Wave J — the six Wave D pages stay minLevel 1 and every martial technique stays banded 4/6/8 (pinned by test): a fresh hero's first drafts must play exactly as before the wave.

Wave J — techniques ARE spells: they live in SPELLS with a martial classId, persist in SavedHero.spells, and count in spells_learned/spells_cast (deliberate — never split them into a parallel system or metric).
Wave J — castSpell effects reuse existing Combat verbs and the existing SoundName palette; player projectiles from spells are kind 'dagger' (friendly), never 'bolt' (hostile).

Wave K — hit-stop scales ONLY the playing sim: the single seam is updatePlaying(this.juice.simDt(dt)). Juice/shake/particles/lighting and banner/overlay timers tick on REAL dt at the top of onUpdate; BaseGame accrues gameTime BEFORE onUpdate so timePlayedMs never sees a freeze. Never scale the dt handed to BaseGame.update, never early-return onUpdate for a freeze, and never let a freeze touch town/overlay states (flow tests idle fixed frame counts there).

Wave K — juice is VIEW-ONLY: hitStop/flashLight/curtain must never gate gameplay (loadFloor stays synchronous under the curtain); enrageFlash/flash/hitFlash-style entity fields are view feedback, never logic inputs.

Wave K — new canvas drawing stays on the MAIN ctx using jest-stubbed verbs (fillRect/arc/moveTo/lineTo/stroke; gradient-free vignettes); any NEW offscreen buffer must copy Lighting's createRadialGradient feature-detect or the test canvas stub throws.

Wave L — dice roll INTERNALLY at the damage/heal call sites on the LIVE run rng (game/Combat/Enemy level); the generator never rolls damage and damagePlayer(amount, cause) keeps taking a plain NUMBER. NEVER show dice notation in combat or on cards — results only (the sheet/class cards may name the hit die: 'HIT DIE d10').

Wave L — kit.maxHp === kit.hitDie for every class (level 1 opens at the die's maximum; classes.test pins it). LEVEL_GAINS rows carry NO hp — the pool is the hero's OWN kept hpRolls, and gains().hp must stay their sum.

Wave L — SavedHero.hpRolls sanitize: EXACTLY level-1 entries, each clamped [1, hitDie], absent/short entries backfill averageHpRoll(die) — a veteran or corrupt save must land mid-pool, never punished, never inflated. confirmLevelUp clamps its incoming roll the same way.

Wave L — CON's HP share is PER HIT DIE (conDelta × CON_HP_PER_LEVEL × level). Player.level mirrors the hero's level: applyProgression sets it (5th arg at BOTH arm sites), gainLevelBenefits increments it; a new arm site that forgets the level arg silently halves deep-CON heroes.

Wave L — every death-cheat (phoenix / survivor / halfling luck) returns at ceil(maxHp × PLAYER.REVIVE_FRAC) via Player.reviveHp(); never reintroduce flat revive HP. 'Bloodied' thresholds (danger stinger, HUD vignette/beat, berserker) are FRACTIONS of maxHp, never absolute HP.

Wave L — floating combat numbers show the ACTUAL amount applied (heals show hp gained after the clamp, via Combat.healPlayer / the PickupResolver gained calc); FloatingText ticks on REAL dt beside particles so hit-stop never freezes the readout.

Wave M — thief skills derive LIVE from hero level + player.statMods.dex (openLocksChance/removeTrapsChance in data/classes.ts); NEVER add a save field for them. Only the thief picks locks or disarms traps (the isThief host gate); every class may spend a key on a chest and it counts keys_used.

Wave M — the generator seeds chest POSITIONS only, behind the CHESTS.FLOOR_MIN gate EVERYWHERE (placeChests AND the secret-room stock — floor 1 stays lock-free, pinned by test). Contents and every pick/disarm roll land on the LIVE run rng at game/system level.
Wave M — chests are indestructible furniture: no boom, blade or projectile path may open or remove one (only mimics pretend otherwise, and that visual kinship is deliberate).

Wave M — a failed disarm springs the trap ONLY through Hazard.spring(); the bite itself lands through the existing updateHazards path (cause 'hazard' — the damagePlayer funnel holds, no new DeathCause). Hazard.disarmed is forever: update() early-returns and dangerous stays false, whatever the clock says.

Wave M — skill percentages on prompts/sheet are readied CHANCES (the 2e thief-skill idiom) and the ONLY probability the UI may show; combat keeps results-only numbers and dice notation never appears outside the hit-die label.

Wave M — the entity turn (updateSwing/updateEnemies/updateProjectiles) lives in Combat and compacts the enemies/projectiles arrays IN PLACE — never reassign those arrays inside Combat, and never resurrect the old orchestrator loops beside them.

Wave N — `morale` is a data flag on EnemyConfig, never on undead, the mindless (slimes/oozes/minis) or the mimic; elites never break (checked at the sweep, `elite !== null` excludes them) and bosses are exempt by construction (never an Enemy instance). moraleBreakChance is designed ONCE in data/enemies.ts — the sweep and every test read the same law; never duplicate the formula inline.

Wave N — a fleeing foe (`fleeTimer > 0`) reuses the WANDER movement branch; it must never fall through to its own behavior's ranged/bomb/chase logic while routed — the flee check sits ahead of the behavior switch precisely so attacks are structurally unreachable during a rout.

Wave N — touch damage from a fleeing or wandering enemy rides the EXACT SAME path as any other enemy (no new damage source, no DeathCause) — a rout changes movement and facing only, never the damage funnel.

Wave N — the stairs camp (systems/Rest.ts) may only ever run from the 'playing' update path; never call Rest.update from town or any overlay state — the state machine, not the internal gate, is what makes free healing in Lastlight impossible.

Wave N — camp heals ride Combat.healPlayer (now public) so the floating number always shows the ACTUAL hp gained — never award rest HP through a side path that bypasses the Wave L heal-display invariant.

Wave N — a wandering-flagged kill skips ONLY the gold scatter in killEnemy (2e's no-lair-treasure rule); XP, score, enemies_slain, splitsInto and any relic-driven drop stay exactly as for any other kill. The `wandering` flag MUST propagate to splitsInto minis or a wandering slime's children would mint gold the parent couldn't.

Wave N — wandering packs are built at GAME level (DungeonCrawlGame.spawnWanderingPack) with level pressure, mirroring the Wave C nest-spawn precedent; the generator (dungeon/) must never gain a wandering-monster concept of its own.

Wave N — any new interact-prompt surface added later must respect the existing E-priority chain: shop pedestal > chest/trap (ThiefSkills) > camp (Rest). Insert new prompts at the bottom of that chain, never above the shop.

Wave N — new timers on view-only feedback (denied flashes, tints, etc.) must tick on REAL dt at the top of onUpdate beside bannerTimer, never inside a system's update() that only runs during 'playing' sim time — the MerchantShop extraction got this wrong once (deniedFlash stalled under hit-stop and froze outside play) and was fixed with a dedicated tickFlash(dt) entry point; follow that shape for anything similar.

Wave O — ONLY the shrine path may veil or curse: the stair draft and dungeon-shop relics always grant identified through the untouched grantRelic. All veil/curse rolls land on the LIVE rng at collect (the scroll-identity precedent) inside PickupResolver.grantShrineRelic — never at generation.

Wave O — the hero carries at most ONE curse: a second cursed find must never replace, stack, or re-count the metric ('THE CURSE HOLDS ITS GRIP' is the only outcome). curses_suffered fires ONLY when a curse actually takes hold.

Wave O — curse maluses are ONE fold each in Player (the relic-read idiom) and never touch the damagePlayer funnel, deal damage, or add a DeathCause. The gold malus reads through Player.goldDropMult() — Combat's single gold-scatter site must keep reading that getter, never kit.goldDropMult directly.

Wave O — the cling is written at BOTH run ends: recordDeath(curse) takes the curse as a REQUIRED arg (TS forces callers) and openVictory writes hero.curse before saveCheckpoint. applyCurse(hero.curse) lands beside applyLineage at BOTH arm sites; a new arm site that forgets it silently sheds the burden.

Wave O — a veiled relic's POWER is active from pickup; only its NAME is hidden. The HUD tally, the draft owned-count and any future relic display must read Player.identifiedRelicCount / veiledRelics so a veil never leaks a name; death and victory both reveal (veiledNames/curseName on RecapStats + VictoryLedger).

Wave O — temple wares ride the PROVISION machinery with station:'temple' (ALCHEMIST_PROVISION_IDS / TEMPLE_PROVISION_IDS partition ALL_PROVISION_IDS; sanitize whitelist stays ALL). The alchemist counter lists exactly its original three — pinned by test. LIFT THE CURSE is a SERVICE, not a provision: it mutates hero.curse + player and counts via TownCtx.onCurseLifted.

Wave O — the sellsword is NEVER an Enemy and no faction concept exists: enemies target only the player; the hireling takes touch dice in ITS OWN update (Combat.updateHireling) and strikes through the REAL woundEnemy/killEnemy path so kills count and morale sweeps fire. It must never gain a damagePlayer path, a DeathCause, or a save field — one expedition, then gone (resetExpedition nulls it).

Wave P — CONTENT ADDED LATER MUST NEVER TAKE BACK WHAT A HERO EARNED. This is the wave's central rule and it bit in three places: the meta gate reads SagaDef.founding (never `!meta`, or new arcs re-lock THE LAST PAGE); storyStage's 'aftermath' reads storyComplete (founding + meta, never allSagasTold, or a side tale walks a finished hero back a stage); an achievement whose COPY a new wave falsifies gets REWORDED, never re-valued. Any future arc — Wave Q's planar tales included — inherits all three.

Wave P — town dressing is VIEW-ONLY and derived: liveSagaId is pure and stateless (no save field, the storyStage precedent), dressedPalette(null) returns the TOWN_PALETTE OBJECT ITSELF (identity — an undressed town must render bit-for-bit as it always has), and NO gameplay path may read the dressing. The refresh memoizes on the live arc id and lives at exactly two call sites (enterTownWorld + the top of updateTown); never recompute a palette per frame and never let dressing gate anything.

Wave P — a new monster's morale flag is a DESIGN decision, not a default: the flag set is pinned by test, and the mindless (thralls, elementals), the undead and the malevolent stay off it. New biome members go in their biome's row only (families stay home, pinned across every biome at floor 13), behind a floor gate pinned from BOTH sides.

Wave Q1 — THE FIRST TEN LEVELS ARE FROZEN. LEVEL_CURVE rows 1-10 are verbatim, PRESSURE_HP_PER_LEVEL is unchanged (only the CAP moved), and the ten original boons stay unbanded and classless. A hero who never passes level 10 must play bit-for-bit as it did before the ascent existed — this extends the Wave E flat-base and Wave I human-lineage contracts, and all three are pinned by test.

Wave Q1 — the boon BAND gate lives ONLY in ProgressionController.draftChoices and reads the level being REACHED (hero.level + 1 >= minLevel). Sanitize deliberately does NOT band-check: a learned boon is learned (the Wave J spell-band rule, and the same reason a cross-class technique is dropped but an out-of-band one is not).

Wave Q1 — HARDINESS may never reduce a wound below 1 and EVASION may never answer a creature's blow (2e's rule: the rogue's skill is for blasts and fixed-point missiles). No great boon may make the hero untouchable; the arcade's contract is that a blow always lands.

Wave Q1 — DEATH BLOW kills through the REAL path (it sets the wound to what is left, never a side kill), so drops, splitsInto, the morale sweep and every metric fire exactly as for any other kill. It never touches an elite (elite !== null) and rides the SWORD only.

Wave Q1 — DREAD feeds INTO moraleBreakChance as an argument. The Wave N law stays designed in exactly ONE place; never adjust a break roll at the call site, and CHANCE_CAP must keep the last word so no training routs a room outright.

Wave Q1 valve — the absorption chain is Player.absorbBlow(kind, rng) and its ORDER IS THE CONTRACT: deterministic stone-sense first (never spent on a blow a later roll would have dodged), then EVASION, then Blur Cloak. It takes a cause-free BlowKind so Player never learns the bestiary, and it returns WHICH absorption fired so damagePlayer keeps the funnel, the consequences and the feedback. Never resurrect the chain inline in the orchestrator.

Wave Q1 — takeDamage returns the HP ACTUALLY LOST (0 = absorbed/i-framed, so the old `if (!applied)` guard still reads the same). The floating number must show THAT, never the raw roll — HARDINESS soaks inside it, and the Wave L rule is that combat numbers show what landed.

Wave O valve — the stair relic draft lives in DraftFlow (seeded (runSeed ^ floor*0x85ebca6b), never the live rng — determinism pinned by the characterization suite) and the recap lifecycle in RecapFlow (the game assembles RecapStats; counters stay in the game). Never resurrect either flow inline in the orchestrator.
